messages:
nate_pm: Quick sync re: Pilot-Coda. Customer wants firm commitments before we agree to SLA: tenant isolation, customer-managed KMS/HSM, and a p95 latency target for UI flows.
claire_runtime: Need concrete trace examples (token lengths, histogram). Also decide fallback approach: quantize-on-latency vs. queueing/backpressure.
mike_infra: Capacity note: we can hold 3 GPU slots (2 steady, 1 burst) with a 21-day lead time. Prewarm soak = 72h. VPC peering adds ~3 days to setup.
anya_sec: Security gating: HSM attestation report, mTLS (mutual TLS) for ingress, proof of SIEM forwarding, and automated log-scrub (no key IDs). Snapshots must be sanitized.
tess_eng: App-side plan: feature-flag rollout, 3% canary for 24h, automated rollback script, and blackbox quality checks. I'll add smoke tests and a rollback.sh.
nate_pm: Product proposes p95 <= 240ms for <=256-token interactive traces and top-3 overlap >= 0.9 vs baseline on eval set. Fallback allowed but must not introduce silent regressions.
claire_runtime: Runtime commitments we can make for pilot: support fp16 and q4_0 quant; int8 is experimental. Provide compatibility matrix + routing runbook. Latency-first fallback is doable: trigger on sustained p99 > 1.2s.
mike_infra: Loadtest ask: 48h soak at 1.25x expected traffic plus a 15m 3x spike. We need LOI to schedule.
anya_sec: I'll prepare an attestation checklist and CI log-scrub job by Wed. Also require a small test proving key IDs are hashed before logs leave our edge.
tess_eng: I'll land smoke tests and rollback script by Thu and wire quality webhooks into the checklist.
claire_runtime: Draft routing snippet for runbook: route { policy: "latency" canary: 0.03 fallback_trigger: "p99>1200ms_5m" fallback_model: "coda-q4_0" preserve_kv: true prewarm: true }
nate_pm: Action owners & dates: claire_runtime -> compatibility matrix + routing runbook (Tue); mike_infra -> capacity hold + prewarm schedule (Wed); anya_sec -> attestation checklist + CI scrub job (Wed); tess_eng -> smoke tests + rollback script (Thu); nate_pm -> consolidate acceptance doc and send to customer (Fri).
pm-bot: TASK-10021 created: "coda-pilot-onboard" and prewarm job tentatively scheduled for 2024-09-15 03:00 UTC :white_check_mark:
anya_sec: Small addendum: customer-managed KMS means we must prove no key material is ever present in backups or logs. Add that gate.
claire_runtime: Acknowledged. We'll include a synthetic run to validate log artifacts are clean and publish the regression-risk note.
nate_pm: Ok reconvene Friday 9:30am PT to sign artifacts. If owners hit dates we can offer a pilot window starting 2024-09-22. Thanks all :thumbsup:
